title: Fuzzy supertertiary interactions within PSD-95 enable ligand binding.
authors: Hamilton, George L; Saikia, Nabanita; Basak, Sujit; Welcome, Franceine S; Wu, Fang; Kubiak, Jakub; Zhang, Changcheng; Hao, Yan; Seidel, Claus A M; Ding, Feng; Sanabria, Hugo; Bowen, Mark E
one_liner_zh: 该文结合离散分子动力学与单分子FRET研究PSD-95支架蛋白的PDZ3超三级结构动态及其对配体结合的调控，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-配体互作与动态构象建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The scaffold protein PSD-95 links postsynaptic receptors to sites of presynaptic neurotransmitter release. Flexible linkers between folded domains in PSD-95 enable a dynamic supertertiary structure. Interdomain interactions within the PSG supramodule, formed by PDZ3, SH3, and Guanylate Kinase domains, regulate PSD-95 activity. Here we combined discrete molecular dynamics and single molecule Forster resonance energy transfer (FRET) to characterize the PSG supramodule, with time resolution spanning picoseconds to seconds. We used a FRET network to measure distances in full-length PSD-95 and model the conformational ensemble. We found that PDZ3 samples two conformational basins, which we confirmed with disulfide mapping. To understand effects on activity, we measured binding of the synaptic adhesion protein neuroligin. We found that PSD-95 bound neuroligin well at physiological pH while truncated PDZ3 bound poorly. Our hybrid structural models reveal how the supertertiary context of PDZ3 enables recognition of this critical synaptic ligand.
abstract_zh: 支架蛋白PSD-95将突触后受体与突触前神经递质释放位点连接起来。PSD-95中折叠结构域之间的柔性连接子使其具有动态的超三级结构。由PDZ3、SH3和鸟苷酸激酶结构域形成的PSG超模块内的结构域间相互作用调节PSD-95的活性。在此，我们结合离散分子动力学和单分子福斯特共振能量转移（FRET）来表征PSG超模块，时间分辨率跨越皮秒到秒。我们使用FRET网络测量全长PSD-95中的距离，并建模构象系综。我们发现PDZ3采样两个构象盆地，并通过二硫键作图确认了这一点。为了理解对活性的影响，我们测量了突触粘附蛋白神经连接蛋白的结合。我们发现PSD-95在生理pH下能良好地结合神经连接蛋白，而截短的PDZ3结合较差。我们的混合结构模型揭示了PDZ3的超三级结构背景如何使其能够识别这一关键的突触配体。
